title: Cabinet (CAB) signature
summary: A Microsoft Cabinet (CAB) file begins with the 4-byte signature 'MSCF' (0x4D 0x53 0x43 0x46) followed by 4 reserved bytes, total size (4), first file offset (4), and 3 reserved bytes.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: CAB files use LZX or MSZIP compression.
CAB is used for Windows installers, drivers, and updates.
CAB supports spanning (split across multiple files).
